2 Kings 21 · The Wickedness of Manasseh and Amon

precepts.text: Nebuchadnezzar, a Babylonian, reigns over the Assyrians in Nineveh, showing Babylon rising to take all that Assyria held.
precepts.point: The history shows a power struggle beginning, where Assyrian kings ruled over Babylon, and later Babylonian kings ruled over Assyria; Manasseh sleeps with his fathers and Amon his son reigns.

note.label: 2 Kings 21: The Wickedness of Manasseh and Amon

precepts.why:
“In the twelfth year of the reign of Nabuchodonosor, who reigned in Nineve, the great city.”

Nebuchadnezzar, a Babylonian, reigns over the Assyrians in Nineveh. In Manasseh’s day the captains of the king of Assyria carried him to Babylon, then a province under Assyria. Later the order is turned: Babylonian kings rule over Assyria. Babylon is rising to take all that Assyria held.
